subject: Combo-swap safeguard & tier reblend for Clearline
messages:
From: Dr. Priya Rao <priya@clearline.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearline.com
Date: Sun, 07 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re-evaluating our plan: need a smoother path between tiers

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. We like Redwood’s latency profile, but our leadership is nervous about the bursty month-to-month spend. A few asks from procurement & engineering: 

- Can Clearline move between your Compact and Throughput1 tiers without a 30-day notice? We need a safer, near-immediate swap during pilot spikes.
- Can we bundle the re-ranking add-on into the base for the first 90 days? That’s a blocker for stopping our evaluation.
- Any room on term-based credits if we commit to a Dedicated pilot Q2?

I attached a quick usage snapshot and the draft SOW the engineering team sent. Hoping to keep this simple — can you propose a short, low-risk swap plan we can take to our CFO?

Best,
Priya
Dr. Priya Rao
Head of ML Platforms, Clearline Health

Attachments: Clearline_Usage_Snapshot_Mar2027.csv, Clearline_SOW_v2.pdf

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Rao <priya@clearline.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re-evaluating our plan: need a smoother path between tiers

Hi Priya —

Really appreciate the clarity and the snapshot — that helps. High-level thoughts: 

1) Safe-swap window: we can offer a "combo-swap" flow that allows an immediate downgrade/upgrade within a 72-hour window for pilot customers; outside of that window a 7-day automated cool-down applies. During a combo-swap the system keeps a shadow allocation so you won’t lose cached KV contexts.

2) Re-ranking add-on: we can include re-ranking in the base for the first 90 days as a trial. After 90 days it will auto-evaluate against your usage and we can either roll it into the plan or convert it to a metered add-on.

3) Term credits for Dedicated pilot: we can do a one-time credit tied to a 3-month Dedicated reservation (50% of estimated monthly token spend up to a cap).

I’ll loop in Ben (pricing) and Karthik (deployment) on constraints and an explicit clause we’d need in the SOW. Proposed next step: I’ll send a short "combo-swap" addendum and a 1-page pricing sheet you can deliver to procurement/CFO. Sound good?

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Dr. Priya Rao <priya@clearline.com>, procurement@clearline.com
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re-evaluating our plan: need a smoother path between tiers

Alex / Karthik —

Priya, thanks for the ask. Quick pricing notes for the addendum we discussed (draft bullets for your CFO):

- Combo-swap clause: Two immediate swap events per 30-day period allowed with full state preservation. Additional immediate swaps incur a small administrative fee (5% of monthly committed spend) unless we move to a Dedicated setup.
- 90-day re-ranking inclusion: included at no extra cost; we’ll provide a usage-credit line item (not a rebate) on the first invoice after 90 days if Clearline elects to keep it as a metered add-on.
- Dedicated pilot credit: one-time credit equal to 50% of three months’ committed spend, capped at $40k, payable as invoice credit over the pilot term; requires a signed 3-month commitment.

Operational constraints (Karthik): combo-swaps require the pilot to run on region us-west-2 or us-east-1 and must not exceed peak concurrent sessions > 1,200 for stateful flows — otherwise we need pre-warming which takes 48 hours.

I’ll draft the 1-page pricing sheet and a short legal-friendly addendum for Alex to share.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Pricing Strategist, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: pricing_snapshot_combo_swap.xlsx

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Rao <priya@clearline.com>, procurement@clearline.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Combo-swap addendum + 1-page pricing summary (draft)

Hi Priya —

Thanks — I’ve attached the draft combo-swap addendum (short) and a one-page pricing summary your CFO asked for. Highlights in plain language so you can forward: 

- Immediate swap guardrails: 2 immediate swaps per 30-day window with KV-prefix preservation; third+ swap triggers a small fee.
- Re-ranking: included for first 90 days; if you keep it, we convert to standard metered add-on with a usage-credit applied to the month after conversion.
- Dedicated pilot: 3-month reservation required to qualify; 50% credit on committed monthly estimate, capped at $40k, delivered as invoice credit.

Open points for procurement: the SOW currently has a 30-day cancellation term — we suggest keeping that but adding the combo-swap exception above. Also confirm which region you want for the pilot (us-west-2 or us-east-1).

If this looks okay I’ll prepare a clean addendum ready for signature (DocuSign link) and a short internal runbook for your ops team describing the swap flow.

Best,
Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Combo-Swap-Addendum_draft.pdf, Clearline_pricing_one-pager.pdf
